bio.text: Charlotte Magoon is the Green Party candidate for Michigan's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, nominated at the party convention on April 25.
In the Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, Magoon wrote of a lifetime mostly spent in Kent County and a BSN from Grand Valley State University in 2009.
In the survey, Magoon wrote of 17 years as a nurse in inpatient acute care, rehab, long-term care and community hospice.
